user_story:
As a user, I want to submit the contact form on the 'Contact Us' page so that I can get in touch with the support team. 
Acceptance Criteria: 
1. I must fill in the required fields: 'Your first name *' (id: 'first_name'), 'Your last name *' (id: 'last_name'), 'Your email *' (id: 'email'), and 'Select a subject *' (id: 'subject'). 
2. If I leave any of the required fields empty and attempt to submit, I should receive validation messages. 
3. After successfully filling the form and submitting using the button (data-test: 'contact-submit'), I should be redirected to the relevant confirmation page or receive a notification that the form was submitted successfully.
